task.description: Implement ADP-09 in backend code and migrations according to src/design/adp-09-tamper-evident-audit-chain.md. Additive schema extension must introduce nullable audit columns chain_hash and prev_chain_hash and preserve existing OBS-03 behavior. Implement deterministic canonicalization and SHA-256 chain computation for new audit rows, per-tenant predecessor linkage, and validation traversal that detects tampering at the modified row and forward. Preserve compatibility for legacy rows with null chain fields and keep existing audit queries/backward behavior intact. Add or update tests covering normal chaining, tamper detection, and compatibility boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Migration adds nullable chain_hash and prev_chain_hash columns without breaking existing audit usage
New audit writes compute deterministic chain_hash with correct per-tenant prev_chain_hash linkage
Chain validation detects tampered rows and reports failure from the tampered row forward
Compatibility is preserved for pre-migration/legacy rows and existing OBS-03 queries
Backend validations pass: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate

result.summary: Implemented ADP-09 tamper-evident audit chaining with additive schema fields, deterministic canonical SHA-256 chain computation, tenant-scoped predecessor locking/linkage, validation traversal that flags tampered rows and forward propagation, and integration coverage for normal chaining, tamper detection, and legacy compatibility boundaries.
